name: Many edge colors without a rainbow four-cycle
description: construct() -> 120 integer colors in 0..119 for the lexicographically ordered pairs (i,j), 0<=i<j<16. No four-cycle may have four distinct edge colors. Maximize the number of colors actually used; all three cycles on every four-vertex subset are checked. The n=16, cycle-length-four task searches extremal colorings for a solved finite specialization, using an independently written exhaustive verifier.

sources.locator: Juan José Montellano-Ballesteros and Victor Neumann-Lara, An Anti-Ramsey Theorem on Cycles (2005). Authors' institutional publication abstract inspected. It defines the number of colors forcing a rainbow cycle and reports its determination for all n>=p>=3. The n=16, cycle-length-four task searches extremal colorings for a solved finite specialization, using an independently written exhaustive verifier.

state_of_the_art.statement: Alon proved that the maximum number of colours on K_n without a rainbow C_4 is floor(4n/3) - 1, which is 20 for n = 16. Montellano-Ballesteros and Neumann-Lara extended the exact result to all cycles. The formula was rechecked exhaustively for n <= 6 (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py).
